description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that provides functionality to show search matches on a scrollbar, including managing match annotations, handling document changes, and updating the display accordingly.

classes.name: SearchAnnotation
classes.description: A class that manages search match annotations on the scrollbar, including finding matches, handling document changes, and updating the display.

methods.name: findMatches
methods.description: Finds all matches of the query within the visible gap and updates the matches list.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles document change events to update match positions and the visible gap.

methods.name: updateAfterChange
methods.description: Recomputes matches after a change and updates the scrollbar annotation.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes event listeners and clears the scrollbar annotations.
